:::{#def-reciprocal}
#### Reciprocal (multiplicative inverse)

The **reciprocal** (also called the **multiplicative inverse**)
[@wikipedia_multiplicative_inverse]
of a nonzero [real number](#def-real-numbers) $x$
is the real number $\frac{1}{x}$ whose product with $x$ is $1$:

$$x \cdot \frac{1}{x} = 1$$

:::
